name: dev.ucp.food.checkout
title: Checkout
description: Base checkout schema. Extensions compose onto this using allOf.

id.description: Unique identifier of the checkout session.

food_establishment.description: Food establishment location the checkout is associated with. In create requests, required when initializing with inline `line_items` and optional when initializing via `cart_id`. Required in update requests and checkout responses.

line_items.description: List of dishes being checked out. In create requests, the Platform MUST include `line_items` (with `food_establishment`) or `cart_id`, and MAY include both. The Platform MUST include `line_items` in update requests and omits it from complete requests. The Business MUST include `line_items` in checkout responses.

cart_id.description: Cart ID for checkout initialization, referencing a cart from a negotiated Cart capability (`dev.ucp.food.cart`) or an out-of-band cart mutually recognized by the Platform and Business. The Business MUST reject requests with an unsupported or unrecognized `cart_id`. Cart contents (`food_establishment`, `line_items`, `context`, `buyer`) take precedence over overlapping checkout fields; `food_establishment` and `line_items` may be omitted or empty.

status.description: Checkout state indicating the current phase and required action. See Checkout Status lifecycle documentation for state transition details.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code reflecting the business's market determination. Derived from address, context, and geo IP—buyers provide signals, business determines currency.

actions.description: Outstanding extension-defined Actions for this checkout.

messages.description: List of messages with error and info about the checkout session state.

links.description: Links to be displayed by the platform (Privacy Policy, TOS). Mandatory for legal compliance.

policies.description: Policies (e.g., cancellation/refund terms) that apply to the items in this checkout. `applies_to` targets are relative to the response root; when absent or empty, refer to the URLs in `links[]`.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 expiry timestamp. Default TTL is 6 hours from creation if not sent.

continue_url.description: URL for checkout handoff and session recovery. MUST be provided when status is requires_escalation. See specification for format and availability requirements.

tip.description: Tip amounts requested by the platform on the checkout session. Business MUST return applied amounts in totals.

order.description: Details about an order created for this checkout session.
